name: Alistair
source:
In the beginning, Alistair is silent enough that it's easy to forget he's in the room. You soon find, however, that on the contrary, his silence is quite loud. Impassive, distrustful, and arrogant when he speaks, Alistair begins to warm up to your presence and becomes your beacon of normality and stability within the nightmare you are living.

He's the only one that hasn't shared his desire, and you can't help but wonder what it is...
